question: The ‘National War Memorial’ inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi is in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 'National War Memorial' was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in **New Delhi**.
 
• It is a monument built to honor the soldiers of the Indian Armed Forces who have made the supreme sacrifice in various conflicts since India's independence in 1947.
 
• The memorial is located near India Gate and covers an area of approximately 40 acres.
 
• The design of the memorial includes a central obelisk, an eternal flame, and concentric circles named the Amar Chakra (Circle of Immortality), Veerta Chakra (Circle of Bravery), Tyag Chakra (Circle of Sacrifice), and Rakshak Chakra (Circle of Protection).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The memorial was completed in a record time of 22 months and was dedicated to the nation on February 25, 2019.
 
• It also includes a Param Yodha Sthal, which houses the busts of 21 awardees of the Param Vir Chakra, India's highest military decoration.
 
• The National War Memorial is a place for citizens to pay homage to the brave soldiers who have laid down their lives for the country.
 
• The memorial serves as a symbol of national pride and a reminder of the sacrifices made by the armed forces to protect the sovereignty and integrity of India.
